name: conn_ffc_fpc
__comment_why__: Added 2026-07-07 — the best-parameterized connector bucket in the catalogue (~80% coverage on every load-bearing spec). Regex matches the two CONNECTOR buckets but not 'FFC Cable (Flexible Flat Cable)' / 'FFC/FPC Connect Cables' (those are the cables themselves — order them to match pitch/contacts/orientation found here). mm dimensions stored as plain numbers via the number parser.
columns: __comment_height__: mated height above board — the constraint under displays
side of the FPC the conductors face; getting this wrong flips the cable.
__comment_thickness__: 'FFC, FCB Thickness' (sic, real LCSC key) — the cable
thickness the connector accepts, almost always 0.3mm.
